items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: I ended up playing with Tina Brooks when I was 18 years old. We had a great drummer by the name of Ronnie Jackson, that was the group, with the B3.

ctx.x: Well that was generally Bagg’s Square. It’s all torn down now. And Birdland was part of that scene down there with a great little scene. They had a B3. Dicky Frank ran the place and he was a terrific guy. And I played there six nights a week for the better part of a year with the great Tina Brooks, a saxophone player, of all people, I ended up playing with Tina Brooks when I was 18 years old. We had a great drummer by the name of Ronnie Jackson, that was the group, with the B3.
